newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted thinly steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted thinly steady to lower.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted steady to lower in bids and offers on Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Friday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 95 percent of tariff, no comparison, no offer.
- 18 barges, Mid-Mississippi River, two each week of June and July, no bid, offered 115 percent, down five percentage points from May 21.
